rationale: Single-ticket PositionClosePartial() is standard, already-proven (D028 Stage 5A's 16 passing tests found zero reliability defects), and required no new infrastructure -- Phase 3's 168 total partial-close events across SR3-PCT/SR4-PCT achieved 100% exact volume reconciliation. A child-ticket architecture was evaluated per the handoff and rejected as unnecessary complexity for a reliability problem that does not exist; the only real D028 defect was insufficient volume (0.01 lots), which percent-equity sizing solves without touching the close mechanism.
